definitions: A task or skill that requires both creative intuition and systematic knowledge or technical proficiency.
Something that combines elements of subjective skill and objective methodology.
examples: Cooking is as much art as science, requiring both creativity and precise measurements.
Effective leadership is as much art as science, blending intuition with strategic planning.
Negotiation is as much art as science, needing both empathy and logical arguments.
synonyms: a blend of skill and knowledge
a mix of intuition and method
a combination of creativity and technique
